New in this build:
- Three live acoustic kits, a real multisampled drum kit: SOUL SESSION (Vintage, Soul & R&B), BREAK ROOM (Vintage, Breaks) and STUDIO A (Modern, Pop). Each drum was recorded at several strengths: a soft hit plays a soft recording, so ghost notes sound like ghost notes, not a loud hit turned down. Repeated hits switch between recordings, so nothing machine-guns.
- Kick, snare, rimshot, cross-stick, closed / half-open / open hi-hat, two toms, ride and crash, from Versilian Studios' Virtuosity Drums (free, CC0). Clap, 808 and perc pads use stock sounds.
- From the last build: HUMANIZE plays like a live drummer.
Please try: load SOUL SESSION, finger-drum the snare soft and hard with VELOCITY up, then play a neo soul pattern with HUMANIZE at 50% to 100%.
